channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Weerar internet oo gaaray qaboojiyeyaasha suuqyada waaweyn ee dhowr dal oo Yurub ah
item.description: Weerar internet ah oo lagu qaaday nidaamka xakameynta qaboojiyeyaasha ayaa saameeyay suuqyo waaweyn oo ku yaal Beljim, Iswiidhan, Finland, Ayrlaand iyo dalal kale, taasoo keentay in cunto badan la tuuro, sida ay wariyeen Reuters iyo The Guardian. Beljim ayaa furtay baaritaan dambi, mana jiro cid si rasmi ah loo sheegay inay ka dambeysay.

item.title: Baarlamaanka Puntland oo kulan wadatashi ah kala yeeshay siyaasiyiin ku saabsan wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka
item.description: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiilada Puntland Cabdirisaaq Axmed Siciid ayaa furay kulan wadatashi oo uu yeeshay guddi gaar ah oo qiimeynaya wax-ka-beddelka la soo jeediyay ee dastuurka Puntland, sida ay Horseed Media sheegtay. Mas'uuliyiin hore oo Puntland iyo dowladda federaalka ka soo shaqeeyay ayaa ka qeyb galay oo soo bandhigay aragtiyadooda iyo talooyinkooda.

item.title: NBA: Gilgeous-Alexander oo 43 dhibcood dhaliyay, Thunder-na 117-112 kaga adkaatay Cavaliers
item.description: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander ayaa dhaliyay 43 dhibcood oo ah kiisii ugu badnaa xilli ciyaareedkan, isagoo Oklahoma City Thunder ka caawiyay guul ay ka gaartay Cleveland Cavaliers. Donovan Mitchell ayaa Cavaliers u dhaliyay 17 dhibcood iyo 11 caawin, sida ay GMA News iyo TSN wariyeen.

item.title: Everton oo 1-0 kaga adkaatay Newcastle garoonka St James' Park
item.description: Thierno Barry ayaa dhaliyay goolka kaliya ee ciyaarta daqiiqadii 49-aad, halka Jacob Ramsey oo Newcastle ah laga saaray garoonka waqtiga dheeraadka ah kadib laba kaar oo jaalle ah. Natiijada waxaa xaqiijiyay ESPN iyo beIN SPORTS.

item.title: Mareykanka oo Koonfur Afrika iyo Rwanda ka hakinaya ganacsiga canshuur la'aanta ah ee AGOA
item.description: Ergayga Ganacsiga Mareykanka Jamieson Greer ayaa ku dhawaaqay in Koonfur Afrika iyo Rwanda laga hakinayo barnaamijka AGOA laga bilaabo 1 Janaayo 2027, isagoo sheegay in labada dal aysan buuxin shuruudaha. Koonfur Afrika ayaa sannadkii 2025 barnaamijkan ku dhoofisay alaab qiimaheedu yahay ku dhawaad $1.7 bilyan, sida ay Al Jazeera iyo Reuters wariyeen.

item.title: Iiraan oo sheegtay in qorsheheeda xabbad-joojinta ee Mareykanka la dedejin karo
item.description: Afhayeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iiraan Esmaeil Baghaei ayaa sheegay in qorshaha xabbad-joojinta ee Iiraan u soo jeedisay Mareykanka hadda lagu fulin karo laba maalmood halkii toddoba, kaasoo ay ku jirto dib u furidda Marinka Hormuz. Iiraan ayaa ku adkaysatay in Mareykanku qaado xannibaadda badda iyo cunaqabateynta, sida ay Al Jazeera wariyay.

item.title: Jarmalka: Ururka IG Metall oo bilaabay shaqo-joojinno mushaar kordhin ah
item.description: Ururka shaqaalaha ee IG Metall ayaa bilaabay shaqo-joojinno ka dhacay shirkadaha sida Audi iyo Mercedes-Benz, isagoo dalbanaya kororka mushaarka 5% ee ku dhawaad 3.7 milyan oo shaqaale ah. Ururka ayaa diiday dalabka loo-shaqeeyayaasha oo uu ku tilmaamay mushaar dhimis dhab ah, sida ay Al Jazeera iyo Reuters wariyeen.

item.title: Hindiya oo sheegtay inay xorreysay markabka kalluumeysiga Azini oo laga afduubay xeebaha Bari
item.description: Dowladda Hindiya ayaa sheegtay in ciidamadeeda badda iyo cirka ay hawlgal 48 saac ah oo Badweynta Hindiya ka dhacay ku xorreeyeen markabka kalluumeysiga Azini oo calanka Iiraan wata iyo 20 shaqaale ah oo saarnaa, sida ay Horseed Media wariyay. Markabka ayaa la sheegay in la afduubay 29 Oktoobar inta u dhaxaysa Bandar Beyla iyo Xaafuun.

item.title: Ukraine: 24 qof oo ku dhintay duqeyn lagu qaaday xarun gargaar oo ku taal gobolka Zaporizhzhia
item.description: Hay'adda gurmadka degdegga ah ee Ukraine ayaa sheegtay in 24 qof ay ku dhinteen duqeyn Ruushka lagu eedeeyay oo ku dhacday iskuul loo isticmaali jiray xarun gargaar oo ku yaal tuulada Komyshuvakha. Madaxweyne Zelenskyy ayaa cambaareeyay weerarka, halka Ruushka uu horay u beeniyay inuu bartilmaameedsado dadka rayidka ah, sida ay Al Jazeera wariyay.

item.title: Faransiiska: dibadbaxyada ardayda dugsiyada sare oo dib u bilowday, balse si yar
item.description: Ardayda dugsiyada sare ee Faransiiska ayaa dib u bilaabay dibadbaxyadii kadib fasax laba toddobaad ah, balse Wasaaradda Waxbarashadu waxay sheegtay in Isniintii 41 dugsi oo keliya la xiray, halkii toddobaadyadii hore boqollaal la xiri jiray, sida uu sheegay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Abdullah Öcalan oo loo wareejiyay qayb cusub oo ka mid ah xabsiga jasiiradda İmralı
item.description: Turkiga ayaa Abdullah Öcalan, aasaasihii xisbiga PKK ee xiran, u wareejiyay qayb cusub oo laga dhisay xabsiga jasiiradda İmralı, sida ay sheegeen xildhibaanno ka tirsan xisbiga DEM, ayuu yiri Al Jazeera.

item.title: Maxkamad Brooklyn ku taal oo bilaabaysa dacwadda laba ciyaaryahan oo MLB ah oo lagu eedeeyay khamaar
item.description: Emmanuel Clase iyo Luis Ortiz oo hore ugu ciyaari jiray Cleveland Guardians ayaa maxkamad federaal oo ku taal Brooklyn ka wajahaya dacwad ay xeer-ilaaliyayaashu ku eedeeyeen inay lacag ka qaateen laba khamaarle, waxayna labaduba ku doodeen inaysan dambi gelin, sida uu sheegay Al Jazeera oo xiganaya AP.

item.title: Telefishinka dowladda Shiinaha oo sii wada joojinta ciyaaraha Real Madrid kadib muranka Mbappé
item.description: Labada kanaal ee isboortiga CCTV ma aysan baahin guushii 3-0 ee Real Madrid ay Axaddii ka gaartay Racing Santander, iyadoo muranka ka dhashay muuqaal Kylian Mbappé uu ku hadlay Mao Zedong uu weli socdo, sida uu sheegay Al Jazeera oo xiganaya AFP.

item.title: Bangladesh: dibadbaxyada shaqaalaha warshadaha dharka oo maalintii saddexaad socda
item.description: Boqollaal warshadood oo dhar ah oo Bangladesh ku yaal ayaa hawshoodu carqaladowday iyadoo shaqaaluhu ay ka dibadbaxayaan mushahar yar iyo qaali noqoshada nolosha, sida uu sheegay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Guddoomiyaha Hebron oo sheegay in ciidamada Israa'iil ka baxeen magaalada kadib 10 maalmood oo go'doomin ah
item.description: Guddoomiyaha Hebron Khaled Dudin ayaa Isniintii sheegay in ciidamada Israa'iil ay ka baxeen magaalada ku taal Daanta Galbeed kadib go'doomin socotay 10 maalmood, ciidamada amniga Falastiinna ayaa la wareegay deegaanka, sida uu sheegay Al Jazeera.

item.title: NBA: Yaxel Lendeborg oo 37 dhibcood dhaliyay, Warriors-na 124-112 kaga adkaatay Clippers
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka sannadkiisa koowaad ee Golden State Warriors Yaxel Lendeborg ayaa dhaliyay 37 dhibcood, waana tirada ugu badan ee ciyaaryahan cusub oo Warriors ah dhaliyo tan iyo Stephen Curry 2010, sida ay ESPN sheegtay.

item.title: Puntland oo diiwaangelinaysa ciidamo ay Mareykanku ku tababarayaan saldhig ku yaal Boosaaso
item.description: Maamulka Puntland ayaa bilaabay diiwaangelinta ku dhawaad 100 askari oo ka kala socda cutubyo amni oo kala duwan, kuwaas oo Mareykanku ku tababari doono saldhig ciidan oo ku yaal Boosaaso, sida uu sheegay Garowe Online oo xiganaya warbaahinta maxalliga ah.

item.title: Kimi Antonelli oo noqday horyaalka adduunka ee ugu da’da yar taariikhda Formula 1
item.description: Darawalka Mercedes Kimi Antonelli oo 20 jir ah ayaa kaalinta 3-aad ka galay Mexico City Grand Prix, wuxuuna ku guuleystay horyaalnimada darawallada, halka Max Verstappen uu ku guuleystay tartanka, sida ay FIA sheegtay.

item.title: Serie A: Juventus oo 2-0 garaacday Napoli, Lazio oo kaalinta koowaad qabsatay
item.description: Juventus ayaa 2-0 kaga adkaatay Napoli oo 10 ciyaartoy ku dhammeysatay, halka Lazio oo 2-1 garaacday Cagliari ay markii ugu horreysay 16 sano kadib hoggaanka Serie A qabsatay, sida ay Football Italia ku warantay.

item.title: Baarlamaanka Carabta oo cambaareeyay weerarkii markabka gaaska ee Qatar
item.description: Baarlamaanka Carabta ayaa si adag u cambaareeyay bartilmaameedsiga markabka gaaska dareeraha ah (LNG) ee Al Mayeda ee Qatar, intii uu marayay Gacanka Carabta, wuxuuna ka digay in weerarradaas ay khatar ku yihiin amniga gobolka iyo sahayda tamarta, sida ay SONNA ku warantay.

item.title: Isbitaalka Erdogan ee Muqdisho oo keenay qalab casri ah oo lagu ogaado kansarka
item.description: Isbitaalka Recep Tayyip Erdogan (Digfeer) ee Muqdisho ayaa qaybtiisa baaritaanka unugyada ku daray saddex mashiin oo markii ugu horreysay la keenay Soomaaliya, sida uu Dawan Africa u sheegay madaxa qaybta, Dr. Ismaaciil Maxamuud Cabdullaahi.

item.title: Premier League: Arsenal oo 1-0 kaga adkaatay Liverpool, hoggaankana qabsatay
item.description: Gool uu Kai Havertz dhaliyay daqiiqadii 16-aad ayaa Arsenal u horseeday guushii ugu horreysay ee ay Anfield ka gaarto 14 sano gudahood, waxayna u gudubtay kaalinta koowaad ee Premier League, sida ay AP ku warantay.

item.title: Bundesliga: Eintracht Frankfurt oo 3-1 kaga adkaatay Hamburger SV
item.description: Eintracht Frankfurt ayaa 3-1 ku garaacday Hamburger SV, waxayna u dalacday kaalinta 8-aad ee Bundesliga, sida ay Bulinews iyo IANS ku warrameen.

item.title: LaLiga: Real Madrid oo 3-0 kaga adkaatay Racing Santander
item.description: Real Madrid ayaa qeybtii hore saddex gool ku dhalisay garoonka Racing Santander, waxayna gaartay guushii lixaad oo isku xigta, sida ay muujiyeen warbixinnada kooxda iyo ESPN.

item.title: SomBank iyo IBS Bank oo maalgelin Islaami ah u fidiyay kalluumeysatada Soomaaliyeed
item.description: SomBank ayaa sheegtay inay kalluumeysatada Soomaaliyeed siisay maalgelin Islaami ah oo gaareysa ilaa $2 milyan, halka IBS Bank ay soo bandhigtay adeeg cusub oo lagu magacaabo “Kalluun Kaabe”, sida ay Dawan Africa ku warantay.

item.title: Barnaamijka Saudi Noor oo Muqdisho ka bilaabay daaweyn iyo qalliin bilaash ah oo indhaha
item.description: Barnaamijka bani’aadminnimo ee Saudi Noor 2026 ayaa Isbitaalka Madiina ee Muqdisho ka bilaabay adeegyo bilaash ah oo daryeelka indhaha, kuwaas oo lagu wado inay gaaraan ku dhawaad 500 bukaan, sida ay Dawan Africa ku warantay.

item.title: Ligue 1: Marseille oo 2-0 kaga adkaatay Toulouse garoonka Vélodrome
item.description: Olympique de Marseille ayaa 2-0 ku garaacday Toulouse ciyaar ka tirsan wareegga 9-aad ee Ligue 1, sida ay Foot Mercato ku warantay.

item.title: Shirka COP17 oo Yerevan ku ansixiyay qorshe lagu dardargelinayo ilaalinta dabeecadda
item.description: Dalalka ka qeybgalay Shirka QM ee Kala-duwanaanshaha Noolaha (COP17) ee caasimadda Armenia ayaa ku heshiiyay “Yerevan Pathway”, oo ah qorshe lagu dardargelinayo 23-ka hadaf ee la doonayo in la gaaro 2030, sida ay UN News ku warantay.

item.title: Mo Ibrahim: Dimuqraadiyadda iyo xuquuqda aadanaha Afrika waa hoos u dhacayaan
item.description: Mo Ibrahim, aasaasaha hay’adda Mo Ibrahim Foundation, ayaa wakaaladda AFP u sheegay in dimuqraadiyadda iyo xuquuqda aadanaha ay Afrika hoos ugu dhacayaan. Tusmada hay’addu waxay muujisay horumar dhaqaale, balse hoos u dhac xagga amniga iyo ka qeybgalka dadweynaha.

item.title: Madaxweyne Cirro oo Hargeysa ku guddoomay warqadaha aqoonsiga safiirka Israa’iil
item.description: Sida ay Dawan Africa ku warantay, Madaxweynaha Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro) ayaa Axaddii qasriga madaxtooyada ee Hargeysa ku guddoomay warqadaha aqoonsiga Michael Lotem, oo ah safiirka Israa’iil u fadhiya Somaliland.
